deleteAccount.body: Hi {{name}}, we received a request to permanently delete your account and its data. Confirm below to continue.
deleteAccount.expiry_one: This link expires in {{amount}} hour. If you did not ask for this, ignore this email and change your password.
deleteAccount.expiry_other: This link expires in {{amount}} hours. If you did not ask for this, ignore this email and change your password.
deleteAccount.footerReason: You received this email because account deletion was requested.
deleteAccount.heading: Delete your account?
deleteAccount.notice: Your account is removed straight away. Download any reports you need first.
deleteAccount.preview: Confirm that you want to delete your account
deleteAccount.subject: Confirm deleting your account

familyInvite.expiry_other: This invitation expires in {{amount}} days. If you do not know {{inviterName}}, ignore this email.
familyInvite.footerReason: You received this email because someone invited this address to a family diary.
familyInvite.heading: Join {{familyName}}
familyInvite.subject: You have been invited to a family

layout.footerDefault: You received this email because of activity on your account.

magicLink.body_other: Hi {{name}}, use the button below to sign in. The link works once and expires in {{amount}} minutes.
magicLink.footerReason: You received this email because a sign-in link was requested for your account.
magicLink.heading: Sign in without a password

magicLink.preview: Tap to sign in. No password needed

newLocationSignIn.advice: If this was you, no action is needed. If not, change your password and sign out other devices.

passwordChanged.subject: Your password was changed

resetPassword.notice_other: Ignore this email and your password stays the same. The link expires in {{amount}} minutes and works once.
